description: For every ground valuation \(b\), relational matrix \(A\), and tuple \(\bar t\) of domain terms, \(A\) holds at \(\bar t\) in the specified Herbrand interpretation exactly when its ground reading is true under \(b\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.term_model_truth.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  (b : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.Valuation (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.GroundAtom L))
  {n : ℕ} (φ : L.BoundedFormula Empty n) (h : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.RelationalQF φ)
  (ts : Fin n → Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.GroundTerm L) :
  φ.Realize Empty.elim ts ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.eval b (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.groundReading φ ts) =
      true
